ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 45% white (high-intensity) and 55% black (low-intensity) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and peduncle interface are characterized by solid black pixels. Symmetrical contiguous white patches occupy the lateral margins of both lobes. High-contrast dark linear streaks disrupt the white pixel fields on both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated wide interior angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary along the trailing edge with prominent, irregular peaks and valleys, showing higher frequency of serration toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curvature from the median notch extending to sharp, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white circular pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal points of both the left and right fluke lobes, consistent with localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral fields. Multiple diagonal marks are visible on the left lobe, with more vertical and dense clustering on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes; irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific asymmetrical linear pigmentation pattern within the white lateral zones.
